g.text: GPU: RTX 4090 (pool ADA_24) in US-NC-1, serverless stock LOW: 1.34 USD/hr while a worker runs; …
Data center: US-NC-1, 24.4 ms round trip from here (probe)
Volume: 40 GB STANDARD in US-NC-1: about 2.80 USD/month until deleted
Created endpoint playground-serve-o24a…-pi05-libero-de5ce3 (tq6e…), no worker kept: …
[0:04] starting the container (the first time on a host it pulls the image, about 2 minutes)
[1:28] converting the checkpoint for the fast path
Billing: the GPU bills 1.34 USD/hr only while a worker runs. …
Connecting to pi05_libero (if no worker runs, one starts now: about 1 minute)...
Actions: shape (10, 7) (horizon x action size; the observation was random, so the values mean nothing).
First action after 0.5 s (includes connecting and any worker start).
Round trip over 5 more calls: median 91 ms, max 147 ms; model time on the server median 34 ms.
The worker is still saving the environment and checkpoint to the volume; waiting so that …
pi05_libero: no worker kept … once no client is connected, and GPU billing stops then.
volume … kept: about 2.80 USD/month (`pgs delete pi05_libero --volume` removes it). …
